title: Integrations and assets present in the Model API without a public route: AI agents and connections, semantic search, SAP, REST callbacks and authentication flows, global events (declared gaps with origin; nothing here is implemented). SOAP is the capability integration.soap (soap.json); ODC external libraries are integration.external-library-odc

unavailable.reason: ISearchableAttribute, ISearchServiceConnection and ISemanticSearchNode exist in the ODC Model API (IModelServices.CreateSearchServiceConnection + IESpace.AddDependency) but no job or feature exercises them.
unavailable.evidence: platforms/odc/docs/model-api/OutSystems.Model.V1.md (CreateSearchServiceConnection, AddDependency); no job in kernel/tests (declared, not executed)

unavailable.reason: SAP integration types (ISapClient through the generic IESpace.CreateIntegration<T>, ISapAction, inputs/outputs, structures, callback flow input) have creators in the O11 catalog (the callback flow itself has none) but no job exercises them.
unavailable.evidence: kernel/catalog/model-api-11.55.69.json (ServiceStudio.Plugin.SAP.*); no SAP job in kernel/tests/jobs or jobs-negative (declared, not executed)
unavailable.alternative: none on a public route; the SAP connection is authored by the user in Service Studio

unavailable.reason: REST callbacks (consumed: OnBefore/OnAfterRequest[Advanced]; exposed: OnRequest/OnResponse on ODC) and the exposed-REST authentication flow have no job; the four consumed-callback creators are ambiguous for the generic create (the first assignable factory would win), and the authentication flow has no creator in either catalog.
unavailable.evidence: platforms/odc/docs/model-api/OutSystems.Model.Plugin.REST.md (Create*Callback); OutSystems.Model.Plugin.RESTService.md (CreateOnRequest/ResponseCallback, ODC only); kernel/src/Anvil.Core/Kernel/Verbs.cs FindCreateCore (first assignable factory); no job (declared, not executed)
unavailable.alternative: integration.rest-consume / integration.rest-expose without callbacks; a callback is authored by the user in the Studio

unavailable.reason: ODC global events (IGlobalEvent, IGlobalEventHandler, ITriggerGlobalNode) have no proven job route: the generic create could reach IESpace.CreateGlobalEvent, untested. The C# builder has a primitive that creates and deletes a global event (AuthoringMisc), proven headless only; the handler and the trigger node have no primitive.
unavailable.evidence: platforms/odc/docs/model-api/OutSystems.Model.V1.md:353 (CreateGlobalEvent); platforms/odc/studio/shared/AuthoringMisc.cs:23-28; platforms/odc/studio/builder/features/LabMisc.cs:32-64; platforms/odc/docs/HANDOFF.md (global events 'P H': primitive ready, headless proof only; handler missing); no job in kernel/tests/jobs-odc (declared, not executed)
unavailable.alternative: deliver.feature with the AuthoringMisc global event primitive (headless proof only, no live receipt in this repository); handlers and triggers are authored by the user

unavailable.reason: The O11 model has no agent, AI model, MCP, knowledge-base or semantic-search element: none of these interfaces exists in the O11 catalog.
unavailable.evidence: kernel/catalog/model-api-11.55.69.json (470 interfaces; no Agent/AI/MCP/Knowledge/Search interface); catalog 11.55.69 against Service Studio 11.55.87 of the lane (reconciliation pending, integrator M1)
unavailable.alternative: none in the O11 model; these are ODC features (see ai.agents on the ODC lane)

unavailable.reason: The O11 model has no global (cross-app) event element: IGlobalEvent, IGlobalEventHandler and ITriggerGlobalNode do not exist in the O11 catalog.
unavailable.evidence: kernel/catalog/model-api-11.55.69.json (no GlobalEvent/TriggerGlobal interface); catalog 11.55.69 against Service Studio 11.55.87 of the lane
